WITH T1 AS (SELECT S.BOOKSET_ID, /**账套代码**/ C.BOOKSET_DATE AS MAXDATE, /**账套日期**/ MIN(NVL(B.BOOK_DATE,C.BOOKSET_DATE)) AS MINDATE /**最小入账日**/ FROM BOK_BOOKSET S INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = S.BOOKSET_ID AND C.BOOKSET_DATE >= S.START_DATE AND C.BOOKSET_DATE <= S.END_DATE LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING B ON B.BOOKSET_ID = S.BOOKSET_ID AND B.BOOKSET_DATE = C.BOOKSET_DATE WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY S.BOOKSET_ID,C.BOOKSET_DATE ), T2 AS( SELECT T1.BOOKSET_ID,NVL(MIN(B.HAPPEN_DATE),TO_DATE(#{BOOKDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAPPEN_DATE FROM T1 LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING B ON B.BOOKSET_ID = T1.BOOKSET_ID AND B.BOOK_DATE = TO_DATE(#{BOOKDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE T1.MAXDATE >= TO_DATE(#{BOOKDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T1.MINDATE <= TO_DATE(#{BOOKDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T1.BOOKSET_ID ) SELECT S.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, /**账套代码**/ C.BOOKSET_DATE as bookSetDate, /**账套日期**/ 'QL' as backRange, /**倒起息跑批范围（全量/差量），该字段还未加，故先默认为差量**/ E.BUSI_TYPE as busiType, /**业务类型**/ TO_DATE(#{BOOKDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD') as bookDate, /**入账日**/ E.BOK_DETAIL_ID as bokDetailId, /**账务明细代码**/ TO_DATE(#{HAPPENDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD') as happenDate /**发生日**/ FROM BOK_BOOKSET S INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = S.BOOKSET_ID AND C.BOOKSET_DATE >= S.START_DATE AND C.BOOKSET_DATE <= S.END_DATE INNER JOIN T2 ON S.BOOKSET_ID = T2.BOOKSET_ID AND T2.HAPPEN_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{HAPPENDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD')
LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING B ON B.BOOKSET_ID = S.BOOKSET_ID AND B.BOOKSET_DATE = C.BOOKSET_DATE LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING_DETAIL E ON E.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND E.BUSI_NO = B.BUSI_NO AND E.BUSI_TABLE = B.BUSI_TABLE AND B.HAPPEN_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{HAPPENDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND B.BOOK_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{BOOKDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD')
WHERE 1=1
AND S.BOOKSET_ID IN
#{item}
GROUP BY S.BOOKSET_ID, C.BOOKSET_DATE, E.BUSI_TYPE, B.BOOK_DATE, E.BOK_DETAIL_ID ORDER BY S.BOOKSET_ID,B.BOOK_DATE,happenDate ASC

SELECT E.TASK_ID AS taskId, /**任务代码**/ D.P_TASK_ID pTaskId, /**前序任务代码**/ F.TARGET AS tradeType, /**业务类型**/ G.TARGET AS allDetail, /**是否全量账务明细代码**/ H.TARGET AS taskExeRule FROM SYS_BATCH_TASK E LEFT JOIN BOK_MATCH_RLAT F ON F.MATCH_TYPE = '01' AND F.source = E.task_id LEFT JOIN BOK_MATCH_RLAT G ON G.MATCH_TYPE = '06' AND G.source = E.task_id LEFT JOIN BOK_MATCH_RLAT H ON H.MATCH_TYPE = '05' AND H.source = E.task_id LEFT JOIN BOK_BATCH_TASK_LINK D ON E.TASK_ID = D.TASK_ID WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY E.TASK_PRI ASC
